g.text: Solid underline: key · dashed underline: partial key · double rectangle: weak entity · double diamond: identifying relationship
Nine selected entities; at most four attributes per entity, including the displayed relationship and derived attributes
ExperimentSample is jointly identified by Experiment + Sample + usage_role. The dashed-underlined usage_role is its partial key within that owner pair.
Physical ExperimentSample PK = (experiment_id, sample_id, usage_role). Both identifying relationships are required; neither owner alone identifies a usage.
AncientSpecimen remains a 1:1 extension, not a weak entity. SampleRelationship has its own key; its two roles express recursive derivation.
Same nine-table scope and connector coordinates. Double participation lines mean required references; assay_count is derived, not stored.
